_comment: Built-in Mizo game text. The app ships these as defaults; `bin/rails editorial:import_game_content` imports them into Editorial Studio as game_copy drafts so editors can change them. Placeholders: {word}, {gloss}, {answer}, {first}.

picture_match.title: Picture Match
picture_match.subtitle: Thlalak leh thumal zawm
instructions: Picture en la, a hming Mizo thlang rawh.
Chhanna zawhah awmzia leh sentence chhiar rawh.
picture_match.prompt: He thlalak hming hi eng nge?

spelling.title: Spelling
spelling.subtitle: Hawrawp ruak dah khat
instructions: Hawrawp ruak dahtu tûr thlang rawh.
spelling.hint: Hint: Hawrawp dik lo pahnih kan paih e.

word_search.title: Word Search
word_search.subtitle: Grid-ah thumal zawn
instructions: Letter bul hnai indawtin tap rawh.
Thumal pangnga zawng hmu vek rawh.
word_search.hint: Hint: “{word}” tih thumal hi zawn rawh.

word_chain.title: Word Chain
word_chain.subtitle: Thumal inzawm tîr
instructions: Chumi unit hmanga thumal thar bulṭan rawh.

tawng_upa.title: Tawng Upa
tawng_upa.subtitle: Awmzia hriatna quiz
instructions: Awmzia dik thlang la, hrilhfiahna chhiar rawh.
tawng_upa.prompt: “{word}” tih hian eng nge a kawh?
tawng_upa.hint: Hint: Chhanna dik chu “{first}…” tiin a bulṭan.

crossword.title: Crossword
crossword.subtitle: Clue atanga thumal ziak
instructions: Box pakhat tap la, a clue chhiar rawh. Vawi hnih i tap chuan across leh down a inthlak.
Keyboard hmangin hawrawp ziak rawh. Thumal i ziak kim veleh a dik em tih kan en nghal ang.
crossword.hint: Hint: Box pakhat kan dah khat sak e.

thumal_kawp.title: Thumal Kawp
thumal_kawp.subtitle: Memory card kawp zawn
instructions: Card pahnih let la, thumal leh a picture emaw awmzia kawp zawng rawh.
Card i hmuh tawh theihnghilh suh — a kawp i hriat tawh chu hmu nghal rawh.
thumal_kawp.prompt: Card pahnih let la, thumal leh a kawp zawng rawh. A kawp i hmuh tawh chu theihnghilh suh!

sentence_builder.title: Sentence Builder
sentence_builder.subtitle: Thumal tiles rem khâwm
instructions: English meaning chhiar la, Mizo thumal tiles thlang rawh.
Sentence natural taka a indawtin rem khâwm la, check rawh.
sentence_builder.hint: Sentence thumal hmasa kan dah sak e.
